description:
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Sharuum.
Put Sharuum into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Machine God's Effigy's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Sharuum into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sharuum's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
